scope: Review of 50 extracted SEC term sheets for training/OOS readiness.
baseline: 0/50 verified lifecycle outcomes and incomplete extraction provenance
target: Validated contractual terms plus independently verified outcomes before training/OOS
observed_metric: 3/3 completed providers reject readiness; 3 providers unavailable

strengths: High extraction accuracy for title (100%) and issuer (100%) fields.
Preliminary expected dates exist for market joins, indicating some progress.
blockers: Critical fields like final valuation date (84% accuracy) and underlyings (34% accuracy) have low extraction rates.
No verified outcomes (0/50), raising concerns about data reliability.
Derived lifecycle states (e.g., active, maturity_pending) are not treated as realized outcomes, complicating training.
required_human_checks: Manual review of all 50 term-sheets to validate final valuation date and underlyings.
Verification of preliminary expected dates against actual market joins.
Cross-check derived lifecycle states with source documents.
acceptance_tests: Achieve ≥95% accuracy for final valuation date and underlyings.
Confirm at least 40/50 term-sheets have verified outcomes.
Validate derived lifecycle states align with source documents.
response.dissent: Some stakeholders may argue to proceed with training using preliminary data, citing high accuracy for title/issuer and expected dates.
safety_flags: No verified outcomes pose a risk of training on incorrect or incomplete data.
Low underlyings extraction rate may lead to incomplete risk assessments in OOS models.

strengths: title extraction successful for all 50 documents
issuer extraction successful for all 50 documents
field_errors: final valuation date missing for 8 documents
response.dissent: low extraction rates and lack of verified outcomes raise concerns about model performance

acceptance_tests: Ensure at least 80% of fields are complete
Verify that all outcomes are realized before training

consensus.reason: All completed external reviewers reject training/OOS readiness until underlyings, dates, lifecycle semantics and verified outcomes are fixed. Unavailable providers are not counted as approval.

dissent: No completed provider supported training/OOS readiness.
Gemini and Anthropic were unavailable; Alama was not configured.
AI recommendations are research input, not evidence.
required_next_steps: Fix underlying/date extraction and human-validate all 50 records.
Exclude preliminary expected dates or replace with final terms.
Join as-of market data without lookahead.
Re-run chronological OOS and baseline comparison.
blockers: Final valuation date parsed for only 42/50 records.
Market joins and human validation are pending.
Gemini quota, Anthropic billing and Alama endpoint are unavailable.
next_experiment: Human-validate and correct all 50 records, then rerun the panel on the corrected extraction.
final_devin_validation: Three completed external votes agree on not-ready; unavailable providers were preserved and not counted as approval.
